title: Understanding P-Trap Seal Integrity
description: A P-trap relies on a standing column of water—the trap seal—to create an airtight barrier that stops hazardous sewer gases from entering living spaces. For a P-trap to function reliably, the drainage assembly must be properly vented to prevent self-siphoning during discharge. Additionally, unused or rarely flushed fixtures suffer from natural trap seal evaporation. Utilizing proper venting design and routine maintenance ensures the water seal remains intact and effective.
caption:
Understanding P-Trap Seal Integrity

A P-trap relies on a standing column of water—the trap seal—to create an airtight barrier that stops hazardous sewer gases from entering living spaces. For a P-trap to function reliably, the drainage assembly must be properly vented to prevent self-siphoning during discharge. Additionally, unused or rarely flushed fixtures suffer from natural trap seal evaporation. Utilizing proper venting design and routine maintenance ensures the water seal remains intact and effective.
